_comment: Map script speaker names to ElevenLabs voice IDs. Run `python generate.py --list-voices` to see the voices on your account, then paste IDs here. The IDs below are ElevenLabs premade voices as sensible starting points - swap freely.

WANDERER.note: The Wanderer. Urbane, erudite, delighted storyteller - 'The Rest Is History' host energy: playful scholarly digressions, warm wit. Premade 'George' (British storyteller) - a keeper.

ANNOUNCER.note: Sponsor reads. Smooth, NPR-deadpan, completely sincere. Premade 'Sarah' placeholder.

KEEPER.note: Bellin, keeper of Midreach waystation. Jack Burton trucker-on-the-radio swagger: unbothered, self-mythologizing, talks about himself in the third person. Premade 'Roger' (laid-back, casual, resonant).

DISPATCHER.note: Caravan Guild dispatcher, Lane Law Minute. Clipped, procedural, zero warmth. Premade 'Daniel' placeholder.

PITCHMAN.note: Elven Market pitchman. Fast-talking 1940s huckster energy. Premade 'Callum' placeholder.

RECKONER.note: Master Yaxa of the School of Reckoning. Precise, courteous, quietly terrifying; answers with exact figures instantly. Premade 'Lily' (velvety, confident).

CLERK.note: Clerk Praxa of the Balic west gate. Career bureaucrat, unshockable, reads categories like scripture, secretly funny. Library 'Eleanor' (gracious, authoritative, seasoned British).

KEEPER2.note: Vess, keeper of Saltbone waystation. Flinty, terse, weathered; twenty years of not speaking to Bellin. Library 'Mora' (gritty, raspy edge).

DIRECTOR.note: Madame Ossia, director of Salt View's principal troupe. Grande dame, refined, bossy, treats everything as theater. Library 'Harriet' (British actress).

DROVER.note: Harl, argosy drover, twenty years on the Ring Road. Easygoing working stiff, proud of a knack that is not his. Premade 'Chris' (charming, down-to-earth, casual).

JINGLE.note: Jingle singer for Tsalaxa tag. Bright, cheerful, wrong. Premade 'Jessica' (playful, bright).

INTERN.note: The Wanderer's intern (she/her). bonus01 one-shot, then host from ep009 under the on-air stage name WESTERLY (the wind is always out of the west). Nineteen, quick, a little nervous, funnier than she means to be; minds the set while he is gone. Premade 'Laura' (young, quirky, sassy). Alternate: 'Will' bIHbv24MWmeRgasZH58o.

ERLEENA.note: Professor Erleena Riser, guest from ep009. Voice Design (2026-09-22) after Rebecca Ferguson as Juliette Nichols in Silo - low, husky, measured, a little gravel, faint Scandinavian-British accent, dry and unhurried, warmth underneath. Outlander: says 'week', not 'tenday'.
